description: Why foreign nationals move to Switzerland: immigration into the permanent foreign resident population (permits B, C and L of 12 months or more) by reason (employment within / outside quotas, family reunification, education and training, residence without employment, recognised refugees, hardship case and residence status after an asylum procedure, other), per year since 2008, for Switzerland, EU/EFTA vs third countries, the 26 cantons (canton of residence) and about 180 nationalities. Official source: State Secretariat for Migration SEM, foreigner statistics table 3-30 (ZEMIS). SEM totals differ slightly from the FSO (STATPOP) migration figures by design. Asylum seekers are not included (see asylum_statistics).

history.description: include the Swiss totals for every year (default false)

nationality.description: country name in German as published by SEM, or its English, French or Italian name, e.g. Germany / Deutschland
